Context: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

5. Can a woman employee be granted HRA during Child Care Leave, when taken in continuation of Maternity Leave? HRA during CCL in excess of first 180 days of leave, if otherwise admissible, can be drawn subject to furnishing of certificate prescribed in Para. 8 (d) of OM, dated 27-11-1965.  
6. The Cash Handling Allowance was recommended for abolitioo by the Seventh CPC. Has it been abolished?  
No, it has been subsumed in Cash Handling and Treasury Allowance,
